scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there. I'm checking on the status of my housing loan application. I submitted it a little while ago and was expecting to hear something by now. Can you tell me if there's any update?
dialogue.agent: I can certainly help you with that. I see your application, loan ID LOAN-00178, has been denied.

dialogue.user: Oh, denied? That's really disappointing to hear. Can you tell me why it was denied? I thought I had a good handle on my finances.
dialogue.agent: The primary reason for the denial is your debt-to-income ratio.

dialogue.user: My debt-to-income ratio? What does that mean exactly, and how did it impact my application?
dialogue.agent: The debt-to-income ratio, or DTI, compares your total monthly debt payments to your total monthly income. Lenders use this ratio to assess your ability to manage monthly loan payments and to repay your debts. In your case, the ratio was over 60%.

dialogue.user: Over 60%? Wow, I had no idea it was that high. That's significantly higher than I expected. So, with that DTI, does that mean I can't get this loan at all, or are there other options?
dialogue.agent: The application for this specific loan has been denied due to the debt-to-income ratio.

dialogue.user:
Okay, I understand the application for this loan is denied. Thank you for explaining the DTI and the denial reason. I appreciate you clarifying that.

<Dissatisfied> - I'm quite dissatisfied because while I understand the denial reason, it's a significant financial setback and I had hoped for a different outcome. I was not expecting my DTI to be that high.
